summary: Scopes 026 and 027 received scope-specific source, adopter, release, and current-engine re-reviews. The exact nine baseline failures were reproduced on unchanged Core main, then all nine passed on the revised Core #7 branch. Full Core validation, 386 tests, canonical/Python/WI050 conformance, frozen-surface checks, and two-export normalized distribution reproducibility passed. Dates were advanced only after these checks passed.
